title: Restrictions: App Store
description: Limits the App Store to software updates and stops non-admins installing apps from it.

DisableSoftwareUpdateNotifications.title: Disable software update notifications
DisableSoftwareUpdateNotifications.description: If true, the system disables software update notifications.

restrict-store-disable-app-adoption.title: Restrict store disable app adoption
restrict-store-disable-app-adoption.description: If true, the system disables app adoption by users.

restrict-store-require-admin-to-install.title: Restrict store require admin to install
restrict-store-require-admin-to-install.description: If true, the system restricts app installations to admin users only. Deprecated in macOS 10.14. Use the com.apple.SoftwareUpdate payload key restrict-software-update-require-admin-to-install instead.

restrict-store-softwareupdate-only.title: Restrict store softwareupdate only
restrict-store-softwareupdate-only.description: If true, the system prevents App Store from launching. Restricts installations to software updates only in macOS 10.10 through 10.13.
